real_llm_business_flow.scope: Real TCP Qwen LLM + backend API/Worker/temporary SQLite + Mock TTS + MP3 decoding
real_llm_business_flow.description: 写一段双人中文播客，给初学者介绍太阳系，4到6条简短台词，语气轻松。
real_llm_business_flow.script_title: 介绍太阳系，让初学者轻松了解
real_llm_business_flow.timing_note: One cold model process, includes task polling, LLM loading/inference and Mock audio pipeline; not a steady-state benchmark.

limitations: 0.5B output may violate requested sentence counts, contain factual errors, or fail structured validation; script requires human review.
No real Qwen TTS inference or audio quality acceptance in this change.
CPU inference performance, frontend integration, MySQL and LAN authentication were not validated.
One demo prompt failed strict structured validation; no fake fallback was used. The backend prompt succeeded in the isolated real business flow.
Model ID/configuration is snapshotted; externally replacing service weights at the same URL is not prevented by the backend. Download revision and hashes identify the local tested model.
safety: Original CUDA/PyTorch and podcast-tts environment unchanged. podcast-llm was created by offline cloning; package imports resolve within the new Conda prefix. The old llm/.venv has been removed. Isolated tests used temporary databases; starting local services initialized the configured local database and the live flow created one verification project. Weights, environment, .env and audio outputs remain excluded from source.
